Abstract.AbstractText: Ir-catalyzed ortho-directed C-H borylation of pyrazolylaniline (PZA)-modified arylboronic acids with bis(pinacolate)diboron afforded o-benzenediboronic acids in which two boronyl groups are differentially modified by pinacol (PIN) and PZA. By using this borylation after nondirected Ir-catalyzed C-H borylation, o-benzenediboronic acids are conveniently synthesized from unfunctionalized arenes. The differentially modified o-benzenediboronic acids undergo selective oxidation and Suzuki-Miyaura cross-coupling at the PZA-modified boronyl groups, affording o-functionalized arylboronic acids selectively.
